issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 Appendix B Types (DateTime/Time: millisecond max precision)
issues.evidence: ToString(ToDateTime('2024-03-15T10:30:00.1234')) and 6-digit variants return null on both engines; spec defines DateTime range to millisecond precision (1 ms step), so sub-millisecond literals are invalid -> null is correct strict behavior. 3-digit and coarser all work. Pinned as intended.
